question: Estimate the size of the Indian senior care opportunity (silver economy) by 2030.
idealClarificationQuestions: All senior-care related markets: assisted living + senior healthcare + senior leisure + senior products? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Senior tech (apps, devices, KhyaalApp, Goodfellows): ~₹3,000 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total silver economy: ~₹2.4-2.5 lakh Cr by 2030.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: - Senior healthcare (specialized geriatric services, chronic care)
- Senior assisted living + premium retirement homes

calculationFlow: - Senior healthcare (specialized geriatric services, chronic care): ~₹1.5 lakh Cr.
- Senior assisted living + premium retirement homes: ~₹8,000 Cr.
- Senior tech (apps, devices, KhyaalApp, Goodfellows): ~₹3,000 Cr.
- Senior financial products (annuity, reverse mortgage, health insurance): ~₹50,000 Cr (premium booked).
Total silver economy: ~₹2.4-2.5 lakh Cr by 2030.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Total silver economy: ~₹2.4-2.5 lakh Cr by 2030.
